title: Commonwealth Professional Fellowships (2027 Cohort)
description: A UK Government-funded professional development placement for mid-career Commonwealth professionals: 6 weeks to 3 months at a UK host organisation working in the fellow's own sector, starting from February 2027. Each cohort year, a range of UK host organisations run their own themed fellowship programmes (subjects and host organisations vary by year -- check the official candidate page for the current list), but every programme is based in the UK, so the destination itself doesn't vary even though the specific host and theme do. Fellows receive a stipend of GBP 2,218/month (GBP 2,753/month for host organisations in the London area, 2025/26 rates, likely adjusted slightly for 2027) plus return airfare; fellows arrange their own accommodation from the stipend. Applicants must be mid-career professionals from an eligible Commonwealth country other than the UK, with at least 5 years of full-time (or equivalent part-time) relevant work experience, and must be in employment at application time at an organisation they will return to after the fellowship -- voluntary work experience doesn't count toward the 5-year minimum. Applications for the 2027 cohort opened 28 July 2026 and close 25 August 2026, 16:00 BST; the Commonwealth Scholarship Commission runs a new cohort annually.
org: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
visaNote: This is a short-term professional development placement, not employment; a Standard Visitor or short-term study/work visa route applies depending on nationality, arranged as part of the programme.
